notes.title: Version 1.124
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would collide with the world while inside the elevator.
[*] Abilities "Shrink" and "Grow" no longer affect gravity and now include additional randomness.
[*] Resolved a bug where players remained small after the "Shrink" ability ended.
[/list]
